propos: Access to the reserved modules is granted by IFDD. Send your request: the answer will reach you by email.

message.aide: Optional. Say where you come from — a delegation, a workshop, a network: that is what will let them recognise you.
message.indication: I am taking part in the Dakar preparatory workshop.

hors-connexion: Sending a request needs the network. Nothing has been sent yet.
sans-compte: A request is attached to an account. Create yours or sign in, then come back.
me-connecter: I already have an account — Sign in

attente.courriel: The answer will reach you by email. You can close the app: nothing is lost.
attente.reste-lisible: In the meantime, the three agendas — negotiation sessions, Francophonie meetings, Francophonie Pavilion —, the glossary and the Francophonie pages stay readable, offline included.
attente.jai-un-code: I received a code — Enter it

annulation.question: Withdraw your request?
annulation.phrase: You can file another one later, or enter directly with a code if you receive one.

refusee.suite: If you belong to a francophone network, ask it for the current code: it opens the modules right away.
refusee.jai-un-code: I have a code — Enter it

deja-admise.propos: The reserved modules are open: there is nothing to request.
